buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. The bidder shall submit Tender-specific OEM Authorization (MAF) from the OEM on the OEM's letterhead, clearly indicating the make and model offered against this tender. The offered All-in-One PC shall be cover ed by a 03 (three) years comprehensive OEM warranty from the date of acceptance/CRAC. Warranty shall be provided by the OEM and shall be verifiable through the OEM. The bidder shall submit a clause-wise Te chnical Compliance Sheet duly certified by the OEM on OEM letterhead, clearly indicating compliance agai nst each parameter of the tender specification and the exact offered configuration/value. The bidder shall submit the requisite Make in India (MII) Declaration from the OEM on OEM letterhead, indicating the applic able local-content status as required under the extant MII policy. The offered AIO shall strictly conform to t he technical specification stipulated for the respective item/category. The make, model and configuration q uoted in the bid shall remain the same as supplied and shall be subject to verification at the time of inspec tion/acceptance. The required RoHS Certificate, latest Energy Star/BEE, BIS and ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 20001, ISO 27001 certifications, as stipulated in the specification, shall be furnished by the OEM. Where sti pulated, the certification shall be in the name of the OEM. The supplied AIO PCs shall be brand new, unuse d and free from refurbished/reconditioned components. The equipment shall not have been previously sup plied, installed or used. 2. The make, model, technical configuration and warranty of the offered AIO shall be verifiable through the OEM's official website/OEM documentation. Any discrepancy between the offered and supplied configurati on shall be liable for rejection. The bidder shall have satisfactory past performance of the tendered item or same/equivalent specification within the last 3 years for a minimum quantity of 20% of the tendered quanti ty against a single order. Documentary evidence in support of past performance shall be submitted along with the offer. 3 . Any material deviation, misrepresentation or mismatch between the offered configuration and the stipu

lated technical specification, OEM-certified compliance, or equipment actually supplied shall render the off er/equipment liable for rejection as applicable, without prejudice to other contractual remedies. 4.Inspection: By M/s RITES at the manufacturer/firm premises in India for items manufactured in India agai nst OEM's MTC/WTC/GC. 5. Manufacturer's name month & Year of manufacturing should be indicated on the material or the packing of the material as per specification or feasibility as the case may be. 6. The required RoHS Certificate, latest Energy Star/BEE, BIS and ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 20001, ISO 270 01 certifications, as stipulated in the specification, shall be furnished by the OEM. Where stipulated, the ce rtification shall be in the name of the OEM. 7. Test certificate should accompany the inspection certificate at the time of supply. 8.Makers name and Brand must be mentioned in the offer. 9. The bidder shall have satisfactory past performance of the tendered item or same/equivalent specificati on within the last 3 years for a minimum quantity of 20% of the tendered quantity against a single order. D ocumentary evidence in support of past performance shall be submitted along with the offer. . 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file. 3. Service & Support Availability of Service Centres: Bidder/OEM must have a Functional Service Centre in the State of each Consignee's Location in case of carry-in warranty. (Not applicable in case of goods having on-site warranty). If service center is not already there at the time of bidding, successful bidder / OEM shall have to establish one within 30 days of award of contract. Payment shall be released only after submission of documentary evidence of having Functional Service Centre. 4. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 5. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support. 6. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Supply Installation Testing and Commissioning of Goods 7. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Account Payee Demand Draft in favour of FA & CAO/E.Rly/KOLKATA payable at FA & CAO/E.Rly/KOLKATA . Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the DD along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date. 8. Forms of EMD and PBG

Bidders can also submit the EMD with Fixed Deposit Receipt made out or pledged in the name of A/C FA & CAO/E.Rly/KOLKATA . The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of EMD, the FDR will be released in the favour of the bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Bidder has to upload scanned copy/ proof of the FDR along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date/ Bid Opening date 9. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Banker’s Cheque in favour of FA & CAO/E.Rly/KOLKATA payable at FA & CAO/E.Rly/KOLKATA . Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the BC along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date. 10. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Account Payee Demand Draft also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). DD should be made in favour of FA & CAO/E.Rly/KOLKATA payable at FA & CAO/E.Rly/KOLKATA . After award of contract, Successful Bidder can upload scanned copy of the DD in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy to the original DD to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 11. Inspection Nominated Inspection Agency: On behalf of the Buyer organization, any one of the following Inspection Agency would be conducting inspection of stores before acceptance: Pre-dispatch Inspection at Seller Premises (applicable only if pre-dispatch inspection clause has been selected in ATC): RITES at the manufacturer/firm premises against OEM's MTC/WTC/GC Post Receipt Inspection at consignee site before acceptance of stores: Consignee
